policy_rationale: PR flow first-five policy requires verifying every finding regardless of nonblocking/low labels. The reviewed text rejected either extent-guard failure but did not explicitly attach the substrate-only failure to same-settlement suspension. This clarification applies the already-selected unsupported-interval policy immediately for an identified next unaccounted completed step. It changes no thresholds, rate, integer transfer, replay behavior or account-closure precedence; does not defer to a following tick; and does not claim the proposed producer is implemented or scientifically calibrated.
